title.narrative: Strengthening Civic Advocacy and Local Engagement (SCALE)

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:Strengthen the financial, management and advocacy capacity of local civil society organizations (CSOs) and business management organizations (BMOs);Improve the managerial and advocacy capacity of CSOs to drive policy change and greater public accountability; andProvide technical assistance on countering trafficking-in-persons, and to support grants to local organizations advocating for improved policies in the key sectors.This activity will strengthen partnerships between CSO-led coalitions and networks, targeted Government of Nigeria institutions, and key stakeholders to advocate for and monitor selected development reforms aimed at increasing government systems' transparency, accountability, and responsiveness to achieve higher quality social services in key sectors. Key sectors include health (maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH), population, nutrition, HIV/AIDS, and TB), education (disbursement and transparency in the use of universal basic education funds), economic growth, disability, gender equality/women's empowerment, sexual and gender-based violence, countering trafficking-in-persons, and child early marriage. For example, this activity will work through CSO coalitions and networks to advocate for budgetary allocation and funds expenditure related to MNCH and provide oversight of available MNCH resources by promoting transparency and accountability principles thereby ensuring value for money. This activity aligns closely with USAID Nigeria's CDCS and supports Goal 1-3 of the 2022-20226 Joint Strategic Plan... .
